name: Yoshizawa Takumi
source:
Takumi Yoshizawa is the sixth generation head of a hot spring inn that has been in business since the Edo period. He is currently the lowest-ranking apprentice.

The inn is a hidden hot spring, but because it is located in the countryside it has few customers. He is the sixth generation of the inn's owner, but he has no idea what he is doing, and the other employees yell at him every day.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/momofero/product/ringetsu/index.html]official site[/url]]
